ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixel distribution across approximately 75% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated in the lateral regions of the left lobe and along the extreme trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast dark mottled blobs and vertical striations on the left lobe (roughly 1/3 from left tip); the right lobe exhibits a dense, contiguous low-intensity region with high-frequency, high-intensity point-source highlights likely caused by water interface glare.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: U-shaped central depression with an estimated aperture of 90 degrees and a defined vertical split depth of approximately 15 pixels relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration pattern with low-amplitude (2-5 pixel) variations along the medial edges, transitioning to higher-amplitude jagged peaks at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward-sweeping convex curves originating from the center and terminating in sharp, dorsally-curved points at both lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity pixel groups located at the far lateral tips of both lobes, consistent with localized surface accretion or scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of at least four distinct, roughly parallel vertical dark linear disruptions (rake marks) situated on the medial-to-lateral section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple vertical rake marks on the left lobe and irregular jagged edge loss on the trailing edge of the right lobe distal to the notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense, high-frequency specular highlights (pixel glitter) across the entire ventral surface indicating active water coverage or spray.
